title: Chinese Dreamcore
description:
Everything went black. Where am I? This is a neighborhood from the year 2000, full of nostalgia. But why is there no one around... My good gay friend who usually waits for me downstairs, the lively square, now... 

Not finished yet, it's a test version. Please give your opinions in the comments. There is a dream core easter egg in this picture, can you find it? Welcome to comment.
